name: reformatted-dates
description: The input the first real model run failed on. The source says 'Since 2019' and 'from 2016 to 2019'; compose wrote '2019 - Present' and '2016 - 2019'. Neither period is a substring of its cited fact. ADR-022: the employers are strict and hold, so both entries survive with their drafted periods and a period question each. The second role is stated in no cited fact, so it also raises a vague role question.
